name: smwmusic-shin-megami-tensei-neutral
title: Shin Megami Tensei - Neutral
description:
There‘s a slightly slower version of this track with an additional channel (and slighty altered channels) in SMT if... known as 'Nova‘s Questions‘.
You can switch between the SMT 1 and SMT if… versions with:
set define to #define Version 0, to get the SMT 1 version
set define to #define Version 1, to get the SMT if... version
